cc:Work.dc:title: V34-R1 adaptive preprocessing pipeline
cc:Work.dc:description: Sender-only region-aware filter selection using a frozen CNN GRU controller and real codec trials; standard decoder and frozen Video Swin-T at receiver. Offline fixed measurements supervise only controller parameters.
